posts.title: Strange Acoustics on Mars and Beyond
posts.description: I. Mars Sounds Strange Mars sounds different than anywhere else in the solar system. Mars’ atmosphere is dispersive ; high pitched sounds travel faster than lower ones. That doesn’t happen on Earth, nor likely anywhere else in the Solar System.
